title: Tesla, Uber, and Waymo all get the OK to operate thousands of robotaxis in Nevada
summary: Nevada has approved permits allowing Tesla, Uber, and Waymo to deploy up to 8,000 robotaxis over the next 12 months. This regulatory milestone represents a major step toward widespread commercial deployment of autonomous vehicle fleets.
content: Together, these permits would allow up to 8,000 robotaxis to be deployed over the next 12 months.

zh.title: 特斯拉、优步和Waymo获准在内华达州运营数千辆机器出租车
zh.summary: 内华达州已批准许可证，允许特斯拉、优步和Waymo在未来12个月内部署多达8,000辆机器出租车。这一监管里程碑代表了自动驾驶汽车舰队广泛商业部署的重要一步。

title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
summary: AI training data startup Micro1 has achieved a $500 million gross run rate, capitalizing on surging demand for high-quality training data. The company's rapid growth exemplifies the competitive landscape among data providers supplying the AI boom.
content: Surging demand for AI training data is driving rapid growth for the startup and its rivals.

zh.title: AI数据初创公司Micro1在AI训练热潮中实现5亿美元毛收入运行率
zh.summary: AI训练数据初创公司Micro1已实现5亿美元毛收入运行率，受益于对高质量训练数据需求的激增。该公司的快速增长体现了为AI热潮提供数据的数据提供商之间的竞争格局。
